subject.title: [security] Explicit JUnit result collection follows symlinks outside the remote workdir

question: Should explicit `--junit` and `results.junit` collection be confined to resolved paths under the remote workdir by default, and should any outside-workdir compatibility path exist?
rationale: The source-backed issue is security-relevant, but tightening the reader can intentionally break users who rely on absolute or outside-workdir explicit report paths, which the repository security policy says needs an explicit compatibility decision.

options.title: Confine By Default
options.body: Reject or warn-and-skip explicit JUnit paths whose resolved target leaves the workdir on POSIX and Windows, without adding a broader-read opt-in until a concrete need is accepted.

options.title: Confine With Trusted Opt-In
options.body: Make workdir confinement the default but add a clearly named trusted escape hatch for operators who intentionally collect reports outside the workdir.

options.title: Treat As Hardening Only
options.body: Leave the current reader behavior intact and document that explicit result paths may follow links outside the workdir, accepting the reported evidence-integrity risk.

recommendation.title: Confine By Default
recommendation.body: Reject or warn-and-skip explicit JUnit paths whose resolved target leaves the workdir on POSIX and Windows, without adding a broader-read opt-in until a concrete need is accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant JUnit result collection code and docs trace to this owner in git history.
